examples.name: a11y.spec.ts

exercise.prompt: Sort findings by detector: "missing alt attributes" (automated), "confusing focus order across custom widgets" (manual), "contrast 3:1 body text" (automated), "unclear error message wording" (manual).
hints: Meaning, order and wording need human judgment.

questions.prompt: Automated a11y tools can catch roughly…
questions.explanation: Automation is a floor, not a ceiling: it finds missing alt/labels/contrast, not meaning.

options: what assistive tech actually sees, derived from the DOM + ARIA
questions.explanation: Broken semantics produce a broken accessibility tree — automation reads that tree.
